description: Returns daily OHLCV bars for symbols between start and end, clipped to as_of (default today) so no future data leaks. Max 5000 rows per page; use next_cursor for more.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

name: get_bars
title: Get OHLCV bars
